title: Advanced File Browser
description: Settings of the advanced file browser.

folderUnfolding.title: Folder unfolding
folderUnfolding.description: Show a triangle on each folder row that unfolds the folder in place as a tree.

unixStyleSorting.title: Unix style sorting
unixStyleSorting.description: Sort names in LC_COLLATE=C byte order, folders first, at every level of the tree.
